findings.basis: At peak recoil phase2 both separately visible arms end in closed EMPTY fists (one near the image-left shoulder, the other raised image-right). The unsheathed purple blade, gold guard and lower-right weapon grip/limb nevertheless remain below the raised empty fist beside the hip. This produces an extra weapon-bearing hand/arm or a detached unsheathed weapon; neither is consistent with the required continuous anatomical RIGHT hand ownership. S/SW/W phase2 have one empty hand and one weapon hand, so a clenched non-weapon fist is distinguishable. Preserve armor/cape/wing quality but reauthor affected recoil phases with exactly two arms and permanent RIGHT weapon grip.
